value.rationale: The repair factor measures whether Stirling integer sequences count periodic orbits after minimal rescaling. This proof turns two consecutive, explicitly unsettled numerical-table candidates into the exact invariant for every period and introduces a finite-to-infinite prime-power certification mechanism; the plateau is natural, not an arbitrary modulus slice. No general all-k formula claimed.
